snippet.title: Guns, Princess and Braves - Official DemoTrailer
snippet.description:
Play now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4395460
Guns, Princess and Braves: A Fast-paced Roguelike, inventory management meets tower defense. As a princess in love with a dragon, strategically layout weapons in limited space. Take direct control in battle to crush "righteous" braves with flashy bullet-hell!
